name: Raul Primo
description: Software Engineer specialized in digital products, automations, and AI-powered applications. I work across engineering, user experience, and product strategy.
summary: I have experience building web applications, SaaS products, and AI-based solutions, with hands-on work in frontend architecture, API integration, process automation, and rapid prototyping. In recent projects, I have helped create platforms for financial management, data analysis, digital marketing, and healthcare workflows, combining product thinking with technical execution. I also develop applied research in digital health through a [Master's in Medicine at FMUSP](/#education), exploring the intersection of software, AI, and clinical practice.
